run_evaluate_bleu_scores: run the evaluate module to compute the mean BLEU score from a submission CSV file
run_load_submission: run the load_submission function to read a submission CSV file into a pandas DataFrame
test_main: test the main function by passing a submission file path via the --submission_file argument
review_load_submission: review the load_submission function that uses pandas to read CSV submission files
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional scoring metrics beyond BLEU
